name: cobol-free-format-heuristic-column-80
body: free_reason flags a likely free-format file for code in column 1 or text past column 80, not past column 72 as the SPEC example says, because real fixed-format sources use columns 73-80 for identification. Limit: text in columns 73-80 never triggers the warning. Upgrade to a column-72 threshold only if a corpus shows free-format files that the column-80 rule misses.
